headline: Viceroy Hotels Limited announces rights issue of equity shares; Board approves Draft Letter of Offer
sum: Viceroy Hotels Limited's board has approved a rights issue of equity shares and constituted a Rights Issue Committee to oversee the offering. The company approved the Draft Letter of Offer on 29 June 2026, signalling capital raise through preferential allocation to existing shareholders.
detail: Viceroy Hotels Limited, a listed hospitality company on the National Stock Exchange, initiated a rights issue process via board resolution on 29 June 2026. The Board of Directors constituted a dedicated Rights Issue Committee to manage the issuance, and approved a Draft Letter of Offer—the foundational disclosure document required for regulatory submission to SEBI. Rights issues are commonly used by Indian companies to raise capital while preserving control structures and giving existing shareholders first right of refusal in proportion to their shareholding. The next regulatory milestone is SEBI approval of the Letter of Offer and shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting.
